title: Capillary Technologies India Ltd - 544614 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 26% YoY to INR191 crore and adjusted EBITDA margin hit about 19%; SessionM acquisition closed May 1, 2026.
summary.overview: Capillary reported Q4 FY26 revenue of INR191 crore (+26% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of INR35.7 crore (+28% YoY, ~19% margin). Q4 PAT of INR43 crore included a one-time INR25 crore churn-indemnity income from the Kognitiv acquisition; normalized PAT was INR19.6 crore. FY26 revenue reached INR734 crore (+23%), adjusted EBITDA INR107 crore (+43%, ~14.7% margin) and normalized PAT about INR32 crore. Management also closed the SessionM (Mastercard merchant loyalty) acquisition on May 1, 2026, and cited a $20 million Fortune 500 retail win.

segments.name: Loyalty stack (core platform)
segments.commentary: Management says it is about 90% of revenue; priced per member or per transaction as a system of record. Gross margin on NRR-led expansion is 85-90%.

segments.name: Rewards
segments.commentary: Third-party rewards for banks and telcos; about 5-7% of revenue.

segments.name: AIRA (AI stack)
segments.commentary: A few million dollars of revenue; about a fourth of customers piloting or paying; about 4-5% of revenue per management. Priced on usage/outcome basis.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue expected to cross INR1,000-1,050 crore including SessionM, per management.

SessionM (~$35 million business, 40+ logos, 5 Fortune 500) expected to be EBITDA break-even in year one, slightly positive in year two, meaningful margins from year three; ~INR15 million annual EBITDA targeted over next few years.
Q1 FY27 margins may soften due to salary increments; Q4 margin levels expected to be sustainable.
Percentage margin expansion may be slow in FY27 due to SessionM; absolute EBITDA growth expected to continue.
Organic NRR planned at ~115%, roughly 10-11% growth; new organic logos of INR70-80 crore per year, ~10% growth.
Long-term steady state: ~70% gross margin, 25-30% EBITDA margin.
SessionM upgraded revenue expected to reach ~115 million ARR over 12-18 months.
capex_capacity: SessionM acquisition closed May 1, 2026 after announcement Feb 24, 2026; priced at about 0.5x revenue.
Acquisition-led upgrades: customers move from ~30% gross margin to ~65% on Capillary platform; ~70% of acquired revenue migrates after discounts and churn.
New AI-led migration platform developed to upgrade acquired customers; UAT of 2-4 weeks, with integrations targeted within 12-18 months.
Technology spend about 20% of revenue; US sales team ramped up.
Prior acquisitions (Persuade, Brierley, Rewards) showed a ~4-year cash payback; Brierley and Kognitiv expected to follow similar timelines.
demand_pricing: Large Fortune 50 retailer win: $20 million (~INR120 crore ACV) over 4-5 years, signed March 2026; not yet fully live, with go-live over 6-9 months.
At least 3-4 Fortune 500 wins during FY26, with US new-logo momentum.
Inflation escalators vary by geography: about 3-4% in West, 7-8% in higher-inflation markets; metric expansion adds a couple of percent per year.
Management says loyalty is sticky; 7-8 integrations per customer make switching costly.
Sales spend ~17% of revenue; headcount up ~1% YoY against 23% revenue growth; total cost up ~13-14%.

qa_highlights.question: How sustainable is the ~16-19% EBITDA margin, and what is the steady-state level?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said Q4 margins are sustainable though Q1 will see salary-increment softness; steady state is 70% gross margin with tech 15-16%, S&M similar, G&A 5-7%, implying 25-30% EBITDA margin.

qa_highlights.question: What synergies and revenue visibility come from SessionM?
qa_highlights.answer: Break-even EBITDA in year one, slightly positive in year two; management sees ~INR15 million annual EBITDA potential over the next few years. Revenue to exceed INR1,000-1,050 crore in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: How do ARR (INR765 crore) and ACV (INR121 crore) link, and what drives the gap?
qa_highlights.answer: Run rate is driven by NRR (inflation plus metric expansion) and new ACV; the Fortune 50 contract is not fully live, so further ARR will come in Q1-Q2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What is the sustainable NRR and new-logo contribution going forward?
qa_highlights.answer: Organic NRR target ~115% (about 10-11% growth) plus new organic logos of INR70-80 crore (~10% growth); inorganic focus is upgrades rather than NRR.

qa_highlights.question: Why are costs growing near revenue growth when headcount is flat?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said US sales hiring is expensive; headcount grew 1% vs revenue 23% and costs 13-14%, with continued investment planned.

qa_highlights.question: How does the company pick and improve acquired businesses, and what do they add?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 90% of value is customer access; SessionM is the fifth acquisition. Acquired firms run low margins (~20%) and are upgraded to ~65% gross margin; cash payback ~4-5 years, faster for SessionM at 0.5x revenue.

risks_watch: Percentage EBITDA margin may dilute in FY27 from SessionM's low initial margin; watch absolute EBITDA growth.
Inorganic NRR was 94% in FY26; upgrade pace and migration (~70% revenue retention) determine acquisition payback.
Q4 PAT includes a one-time INR25 crore indemnity income (Kognitiv); normalized figures are the better guide.
AIRA monetization is early (a few million dollars); usage-based pricing and adoption need to show up in NRR.
Large enterprise sales cycles are long; the Fortune 50 contract ramp is pending.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, AI adoption and the acquisition playbook. Management was more cautious on forward margin percentages, citing SessionM dilution, and gave few explicit numbers for AIRA revenue.
key_quotes: We basically offer AI-powered cloud solutions for larger enterprises to run their loyalty programs.
So, overall margins might not show the same or might show a 1% growth, 1.5% growth, but the core business continues to ramp up on margins.
We think this will play out into serious revenues over the next few quarters.
I think we have very good visibility of both revenue growth as well as EBITDA growth for the foreseeable next few quarters.

financial_highlights.value: INR43 crore, incl. ~INR25 crore one-time exceptional income

growth.why: Management guides FY27 revenue to cross INR1,000-1,050 crore (about 36-43% over FY26's INR734 crore), inclusive of the SessionM acquisition closed May 1, 2026, and organic NRR planned at ~115%; backing is partial (a $20m Fortune 50 win signed March 2026 with 6-9 month go-live, plus organic NRR and new-logo targets of INR70-80 crore), with no owned capacity additions.
